blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Justice (DOJ) on Thursday acknowledged the continued presence of small-scale Philippine offshore gaming operator (Pogo) and scam hubs despite an existing ban on such operations. A DOJ official, however, did not rule out a resurgence of illegal operations, as Chinese nationals are reportedly being apprehended for overstaying in the country after entering under a visa-free arrangement. Justice Undersecretary Nicholas Felix Ty made the remark after Malacañang asked the Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) to review the visa-free entry arrangement for Chinese tourists after some were alleged to have exploited the policy.
